research.name: Cult UI
research.note: Components with shader effects such as a dithering hero and a Warp-shader AI avatar, plus a folded-corner card and a morphing Dynamic Island.

effects: Hero Dithering: split hero section with a WebGL dithering shader that renders a pixelated blue sphere
Dynamic Island: composable iPhone-style Dynamic Island that morphs between size presets (the preview cycles long and medium)

notSeen: Fluted Glass: the preview showed only the image picker and controls, not the ribbed distortion. https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/fluted-glass
